description: Hidden onboarding candidate for lerobot/smolvla_vlabench, a SmolVLA-family vision-language-action policy fine-tuned on the VLABench unified robotics dataset. It maps a natural-language instruction, three camera observations, and robot state into continuous robot action traces through the shared Forge SmolVLA HTTP wrapper. The manifest records artifact/license/container evidence, an explicit /mnt/data cache plan, and a machine-checkable runtime-contract gate for the processor discrepancy.
